_readme: Affordances and surfaces that ship in a state the UI register calls a gap.
Every entry is a decision: it says this control goes out like this, and why.
scripts/quality/ui-register.mjs --gate fails on a gap that is not here, and
on an entry whose gap has been closed -- a list of known problems that nobody
prunes turns into a list nobody reads.
Written as a baseline on 2026-09-07 for pdfluent-internal#410; the counts in
docs/UI_REGISTER.md are the measure, and they are meant to go down.

button:add-attachment-btn.reason: rendered by a component nothing puts on screen; it goes when that surface goes

button:export-btn.reason: reaches its handler, and the only test that named it was a helper called exclusively from tests that skip. Found on 2026-09-08 when the walker stopped reading a skipped test as proof: visual-e2e-beta-blockers.spec.ts skips 19 of its 23 tests, and exportPdfAndAssertValid -- the one place the id appeared -- is called from four of them. The control is wired; what is missing is a test that runs. It goes with the rewrite those skips already ask for.
